CreateAIGateway.X-Region: Region code, e.g. bj, gz, su, cd, yq, bd
CreateAIGateway.name: Gateway instance name
CreateAIGateway.gatewayType: Gateway size: small, medium, or large
CreateAIGateway.isInternal: Whether to use internal network mode
CreateAIGateway.networkTypes: Network types: private, public; multiple selections allowed
CreateAIGateway.replicas: Replica count; default is 2 for shared mode, 3 for exclusive mode
CreateAIGateway.installMode: Deployment mode: shared or exclusive; default is shared
CreateAIGateway.srcProduct: Source product; different sources require additional mandatory fields
CreateAIGateway.accountId: Account ID required when source is AgentOS
CreateAIGateway.blbId: BLB long ID required when source is CFC
CreateAIGateway.cpromInstanceId: CProm instance ID for enabling business metrics monitoring
CreateAIGateway.version: Higress version; uses default version if not specified
CreateAIGateway.aihcArgs: AIHC network parameters for aihc-pom source
CreateAIGateway.aihcArgs.securityGroupIds: AIHC security group ID list or identifier
